from pathlib import Path
from decimal import Decimal as D, getcontext
import collections, hashlib, json, struct, subprocess, sys
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import lstsq
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import phase2d_step40_validation as v
import phase2d_step42_replay as r
import provision_original_archives as p
getcontext().prec=100
out=Path('results/ci/validation-repair-20261104'); root=out/'authenticated'
cohorts=('windows-reference','linux-reference','linux-numpy-sensitivity','linux-scipy-sensitivity')
report={'baseline':'60b2e5b2daacb783e9994c90929197306ccb1d53','synthetic_checkout':'c6cd21793c71bbf0d9dc7dd934f3642fa991b52c','equal_tree':'14d7587d3f2dd3375de792579b5badf319679274'}
workers={}; arrays={}; environments={}; hashes={}; source_cache={}
for cohort in cohorts:
    folder=root/('step42-'+cohort)
    state=json.loads((folder/'status.json').read_text())
    assert state['execution_status']=='EXECUTED' and not state['errors'] and len(state['results'])==4
    environments[cohort]=json.loads((folder/'environment.json').read_text())
    workers[cohort]={}
    for row in state['results']:
        raw=(folder/row['result']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
        value=json.loads(raw);r.require_solve_record(value);workers[cohort][row['origin'].removeprefix('step42-capture-')]=value
    capture=root/('step42-capture-'+cohort)
    raw=(capture/'inputs.json').read_bytes(); hashes[cohort]=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    assert json.loads((capture/'input-sha256.json').read_text())=={'inputs.json':hashes[cohort]}
    source=json.loads((capture/'source-sha256.json').read_text())
    assert source['head']==report['synthetic_checkout']
    for name,digest in source['sha256'].items():
        if name not in source_cache:
            source_cache[name]=hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',report['baseline']+':'+name])).hexdigest()
        assert source_cache[name]==digest,(cohort,name)
    data=json.loads(raw);a={}
    for name,packed in data['arrays'].items():
        b=bytes.fromhex(packed['binary64_le']); unpacked=np.array(struct.unpack('<'+'d'*(len(b)//8),b)).reshape(packed['shape'])
        assert unpacked.astype('<f8').tobytes()==b
        a[name]=unpacked
    arrays[cohort]=(data,a)
report['capture_sha256']=hashes;report['baseline_source_files_verified']=len(source_cache)
report['environments']={k:{n:e[n] for n in ('python','numpy','scipy','system','loaded_threadpools')} for k,e in environments.items()}
def independent(a,dense,recovered,failed,digits=90):
    from decimal import localcontext
    with localcontext() as ctx:
        ctx.prec=digits; vals=[]
        frozen=list(dense);frozen[failed]=0
        for amps in (dense,frozen,recovered):
            amps=[x if isinstance(x,D) else D.from_float(float(x)) for x in amps]
            energy=D(0)
            for row,b,w in zip(a['fine_A'],a['fine_b'],a['fine_weights']):
                residual=D.from_float(float(b))+sum((D.from_float(float(x))*y for x,y in zip(row,amps)),D(0))
                energy+=D.from_float(float(w))*residual*residual
            vals.append(energy.sqrt())
        B,L,P=vals;assert abs(L-B)>D('1e-15')
        return {'ratio':(L-P)/(L-B),'B':B,'L':L,'P':P,'gap':L-B,'denominator_condition':(abs(L)+abs(B))/abs(L-B)}
ratios={};checks=[];conditions=[]
with threadpool_limits(limits=1):
    for origin,(data,a) in arrays.items():
        for worker in cohorts:
            rec=workers[worker][origin]
            assert rec['identity']['input_sha256']==hashes[origin]
            for case in ('row3','row4'):
                dense=rec['cases']['dense']['currents_A'];recovered=rec['cases'][case]['currents_A'];failed=data['cases'][case]['failed']
                fresh=independent(a,dense,recovered,failed)
                key=(origin,worker,case);ratios[key]=fresh
                recorded=D(rec['recovery'][case]['fresh']['ratio'])
                assert abs(fresh['ratio']-recorded)<D('1e-75')
                checks.append({'origin':origin,'worker':worker,'case':case,'independent_ratio':fresh['ratio'],'recorded_delta':fresh['ratio']-recorded,'gap_T':fresh['gap'],'denominator_condition':fresh['denominator_condition']})
            for case,x in rec['cases'].items():
                conditions.append({'origin':origin,'worker':worker,'case':case,'condition':x['condition'],'nit':x['nit'],'status':x['status'],'stationarity':x['certificate']['stationarity']})
    contrasts=[]
    for other in cohorts[1:]:
        for case in ('row3','row4'):
            A=ratios[('windows-reference','windows-reference',case)]['ratio']
            B=ratios[('windows-reference',other,case)]['ratio']
            C=ratios[(other,'windows-reference',case)]['ratio']
            DD=ratios[(other,other,case)]['ratio']
            contrasts.append({'linux_cohort':other,'case':case,'A':A,'B':B,'C':C,'D':DD,'input_effect_C_minus_A':C-A,'execution_effect_B_minus_A':B-A,'interaction_D_minus_C_minus_B_plus_A':DD-C-B+A,'total_D_minus_A':DD-A,'execution_relative':abs((B-A)/A)})
    drivers=[];precision=[]
    for origin in ('windows-reference','linux-reference'):
        data,a=arrays[origin];refs={}; solutions={}
        for case in ('dense','row3','row4'):
            M,y=a[case+'_M'],a[case+'_y']
            lo,hi=v.qr_reference(M,y,60),v.qr_reference(M,y,90)
            assert lo['status']==hi['status']=='INTERIOR_REFERENCE'
            precision.append({'origin':origin,'case':case,'QR_60_90_max_delta':max(abs(D(x)-D(y)) for x,y in zip(lo['x'],hi['x'])),'QR90_gradient':hi['gradient_max']})
            support=data['cases'][case].get('support',list(range(24))); z=[D(0)]*24
            for j,x in zip(support,hi['x']):z[j]=D(x)*D(3000)
            refs[case]=z
            for driver in ('gelsd','gelss','gelsy'):
                z=np.zeros(24);z[support]=lstsq(M,y,lapack_driver=driver)[0]*3000
                solutions[(driver,case)]=z
        for case in ('row3','row4'):
            failed=data['cases'][case]['failed']
            qr=independent(a,refs['dense'],refs[case],failed,90)
            for driver in ('gelsd','gelss','gelsy'):
                value=independent(a,solutions[(driver,'dense')],solutions[(driver,case)],failed)
                drivers.append({'origin':origin,'case':case,'driver':driver,'ratio':value['ratio'],'error_vs_QR90':value['ratio']-qr['ratio']})
report.update(independent_metric_checks=checks,conditions=conditions,four_way=contrasts,driver_interventions=drivers,precision_checks=precision)
report['input_array_deltas']={cohort:{k:float(np.max(abs(a-arrays[cohort][1][k]))) for k,a in arrays['windows-reference'][1].items()} for cohort in cohorts[1:]}
c=json.loads((root/'step42-comparison/comparison.json').read_text())
report['record_counts']=[{'kind':k[0],'pass':k[1],'count':n} for k,n in collections.Counter((x['kind'],x['pass_unchanged_tolerance']) for x in c['comparisons']).items()]
report['scientific_acceptance']='NOT_ESTABLISHED';report['production_acceptance']='FAIL'
(out/'independent-attribution.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,default=str)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('Verified source fingerprints:',len(source_cache),'metric recomputations:',len(checks))
print('Counts',report['record_counts'])
print('CONTRASTS',json.dumps(contrasts,default=str))
print('CONDITION',min(x['condition'] for x in conditions),max(x['condition'] for x in conditions),'nit',set(x['nit'] for x in conditions),'statuses',set(x['status'] for x in conditions))
print('GAPS',min(abs(x['gap_T']) for x in checks),max(abs(x['gap_T']) for x in checks))
print('QR60/90 max delta',max(x['QR_60_90_max_delta'] for x in precision))
print('DRIVER max ratio error',max(abs(x['error_vs_QR90']) for x in drivers))
commands.sensitivity_python:
from pathlib import Path
from decimal import Decimal as D, getcontext
import json,sys,numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import phase2d_step42_replay as r
from stellarator_robust.upstream_attribution import unpack
getcontext().prec=100
out=Path('results/ci/validation-repair-20261104'); root=out/'authenticated'
rows=[]; ext=json.loads((out/'independent-attribution.json').read_text())
load=lambda path: json.loads(path.read_text())
for origin in ('windows-reference','linux-reference'):
    data=load(root/('step42-capture-'+origin)/'inputs.json');a={k:unpack(v) for k,v in data['arrays'].items()}
    records={}
    for worker in ('windows-reference','linux-reference'):
        folder=root/('step42-'+worker); state=load(folder/'status.json')
        rec=next(x for x in state['results'] if x['origin']=='step42-capture-'+origin)
        records[worker]=load(folder/rec['result'])
    for case in ('row3','row4'):
        x,y=records['windows-reference'],records['linux-reference'];failed=data['cases'][case]['failed']
        dense=np.array(x['cases']['dense']['currents_A']); recovered=np.array(x['cases'][case]['currents_A'])
        dd=np.array(y['cases']['dense']['currents_A']); rr=np.array(y['cases'][case]['currents_A'])
        base,candidate=r.metric(a,dense,recovered,failed),r.metric(a,dd,rr,failed)
        effect=r.differential(base,candidate)
        probes=[]
        for name,vec,other in (('dense',dense,dd),('recovered',recovered,rr)):
            j=int(np.argmax(abs(vec-other)))
            for direction in (-np.inf,np.inf):
                changed=vec.copy();changed[j]=np.nextafter(changed[j],direction)
                value=r.metric(a,changed if name=='dense' else dense,changed if name=='recovered' else recovered,failed)
                probes.append(dict(vector=name,coordinate=j,current_delta_A=float(changed[j]-vec[j]),delta_R=str(D(value['ratio'])-D(base['ratio']))))
        frozen=dense.copy();frozen[failed]=0
        rms=[float(np.sqrt(np.sum(a['fine_weights']*(a['fine_b']+a['fine_A']@z)**2))) for z in (dense,frozen,recovered)]
        native=(rms[1]-rms[2])/(rms[1]-rms[0])
        low=r.metric(a,dense,recovered,failed,60)
        rows.append(dict(origin=origin,case=case,delta_R=str(D(candidate['ratio'])-D(base['ratio'])),sensitivity=effect,
                         precision_60_90_delta=str(abs(D(base['ratio'])-D(low['ratio']))),
                         native_binary64_minus_decimal=str(D.from_float(native)-D(base['ratio'])),one_ulp=probes))
(out/'sensitivity.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('Max 60/90 difference',max(D(z['precision_60_90_delta']) for z in rows))
print('Max first-order remainder',max(abs(D(z['sensitivity']['nonlinear_remainder'])) for z in rows))
print('Native binary64 absolute R error range',min(abs(D(z['native_binary64_minus_decimal'])) for z in rows),max(abs(D(z['native_binary64_minus_decimal'])) for z in rows))
print('Max single-current one-ULP R change',max(abs(D(p['delta_R'])) for z in rows for p in z['one_ulp']))
print('Max archived current delta A',max(max(abs(np.array(y['cases'][c]['current_delta_A']))) for y in [records['windows-reference'],records['linux-reference']] for c in ('dense','row3','row4')))
print('Input deltas',ext['input_array_deltas']['linux-reference'])
commands.frozen_checks_python:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
out=Path('results/ci/validation-repair-20261104')
records=[]
def run(label,args):
    command=[sys.executable,'scripts/phase2d_frozen.py',*args]
    with (out/(label+'.log')).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as log:
        completed=subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    records.append(dict(label=label,command=command,exit_code=completed.returncode))
    print(label,completed.returncode,flush=True)
    return completed.returncode==0
prepared=out/'frozen-prepared'
if run('frozen-prepare',['prepare','--output',str(prepared)]):
    digest=hashlib.sha256((prepared/'contract.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    common=['--fixture',str(prepared/'fixture'),'--contract',str(prepared/'contract.json'),'--contract-sha256',digest,'--cohort','windows-reference']
    if run('frozen-run',['run',*common,'--output',str(out/'frozen-run')]):
        if run('frozen-repeat',['run',*common,'--output',str(out/'frozen-repeat')]):
            run('frozen-compare',['compare','--reference',str(out/'frozen-run'),'--current',str(out/'frozen-repeat'),'--output',str(out/'frozen-comparison.json')])
    run('frozen-manifest',['verify-evidence','--root',str(out/'frozen-run')])
(out/'frozen-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
sys.exit(0 if all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in records) else 1)
